sources.title: 韋禮安《披荊斬棘》成團！哽咽曝「I型人最大挑戰」
sources.description:
William Wei’s Post‑Show Portrait

Taiwanese singer William Wei stands against a plain white background, dressed in a black button‑down shirt layered over a graphic T‑shirt. His dark hair is neatly styled, and his gentle smile and direct gaze convey both confidence and approachabi
